SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.category_id IN (1, 2, 3, 4) THEN oi.qty * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) AS digital_sales,
    SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) AS total_sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped');

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN p.category_id IN (1, 2, 3, 4) THEN oi.qty * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / 
     SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price)) AS digital_percentage
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped');

SELECT 
    SUM(order_items.qty * order_items.unit_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT orders.id) AS avg_order_amount
FROM orders
JOIN order_items ON orders.id = order_items.order_id
WHERE orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')

SELECT 
    c.name AS category_name,
    SUM(oi.qty * (oi.unit_price - p.cost)) AS gross_profit
FROM 
    categories c
JOIN 
    products p ON c.id = p.category_id
JOIN 
    order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id
JOIN 
    orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE 
    o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
GROUP BY 
    c.id, c.name
ORDER BY 
    gross_profit DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    order_items.product_id,
    order_items.qty,
    order_items.unit_price,
    products.cost,
    SUM(order_items.qty * (order_items.unit_price - products.cost)) as total_profit
FROM order_items
JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.id
JOIN products ON order_items.product_id = products.id
WHERE orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') 
  AND products.category_id IN (2, 3, 4)
GROUP BY order_items.product_id, order_items.qty, order_items.unit_price, products.cost;

SELECT 
    p.name,
    SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) AS total_sales
FROM 
    order_items oi
JOIN 
    products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN 
    orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE 
    o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
GROUP BY 
    p.id, p.name
ORDER BY 
    total_sales DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) as total_orders,
    SUM(oi.qty) as total_items,

FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
